bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS security and compliance controls enabling regulated insurers to safely adopt analytics and ML capabilities within their production environments.
Established an AWS shared-responsibility operating model that clarified insurer-owned versus platform-owned controls, giving regulated customers a governable path to safe cloud adoption.
Led AWS modernization execution to migrate monolithic policy administration and insurance platform workloads to a scalable cloud architecture.
